description_en: Creates an automatic resource group transfer rule. Two types are supported: custom transfer rules and attached-resource transfer rules

parameters.example: 带有标签 {"env": "online"} 和 {"project": "A"} 的资源转移到资源组 rg-aek2********qcy
parameters.name: rule_desc

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
custom_condition: custom transfer rule.
associated_transfer: attached-resource transfer rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
custom_condition：自定义转组规则。

fields.help_en: The scope condition for automatic resource group transfer. Specifies the scope of resources to be automatically transferred
